text: I am 33, girl 31, left me after 6 months. Why does this one hurt? By far not the only girlfriend I had. I have been married and had several partners I lived with. But this one is hurting like hell, like I can't even sleep. I am not old, but I am certainly not a teenager to be hurting this bad for a girl that left me after just 6 months. She shouldn't have been anything special for real. We clearly were not cut for each other, etc, etc. How do you deal with this without falling into alcohol or drugs? I can't sleep, man. It's eating my head and taking away all my mental peace I had before knowing her. Never cried for a woman before and this is making me feel awfully bad. She left me in March, I don't even want to meet or even talk to new people to forget her. It's taking away all my dignity because I found myself begging her to come back so many times. It's ridiculous. The question here is, are you actually doing something? Or are you just lying in bed thinking about her? Because if you are not taking action, nothing will change. Yeah, emotions are hard to control, but your actions, those you can control. First step, block her everywhere. Delete every photo, every video, every chat. If you've got common friends who keep bringing her up, tell them to stop or cut them out too. Next, fill your life with things that leave no space for her. Work, sports, hobbies. Go out with your friends and most importantly, start seeing other women. Go to social events, use dating apps, join social clubs. If you don't feel like it, make yourself do it. It's like taking medicine. A headache pill isn't tasty, but you take it because it works. Same here. And listen, if you genuinely feel like you've got deeper mental health issues, then yes, go see a doctor. But if not, then just follow this advice. Because here's the truth. Once you start seeing other women, once you meet someone who makes you feel good, who tells you you are the best, you will look back and think, why was I even so hung up on my ex? Especially since you admit you were not even compatible. So stop whining, stop begging and start doing. That's the only recipe.
